## PRB1.3. Safety

-   In 2025, Slovenia Control achieved the planned maturity levels set out in its performance plan for all five components of the EoSM. In more detail, Slovenia Control exceeded the planned maturity level in the area of Safety Policy and Objectives.

-   Slovenia has not included any airports in their RP4 performance plans, thus not reporting on runway incursions during the reference period.

-   The rate of separation minima infringements (SMI) was 2.47 at State level and equal to the SMIs at ANSP level, with both indicators below Union-wide average. When comparing to 2024, rate of SMIs has increased at State level. At ANSP level, Slovenia reported 0 SMIs in 2024.
